question: Which newlywed just broke the internet with one hand?
story: Travis Kelce walked into a football stadium, and the entire internet zoomed in on his left hand. According to TMZ, E! News and People, Kelce showed up at Arrowhead on Saturday, August fifteenth, for the Chiefs first preseason game against the Rams, wearing a thick gold wedding band. It was reportedly the first real look fans have gotten at that ring since he married Taylor Swift on July third at Madison Square Garden. He paired it with a gold bracelet and a watch, and social media did the rest. Screenshots. Zoom ins. Frame by frame analysis of a man walking down a hallway. Here is what he said about the summer. He called the wedding the best night of his life, and thanked everyone who came out and celebrated with them. Swift has reportedly not shown her own band in public yet. So for now the internet only has his, and it is being studied like evidence.
